title: Industry Pulse — AI / Agent Ecosystem

bullets.title: Claude ships ready-made legal review artifacts (contract review, citation checks, regulatory tracking)
bullets.summary: Teams start from a sample, connect their own source documents and share the workspace.
bullets.how: The Construct: a template pattern for packaged, shareable workspaces. Brand 9 Signs: contract/vendor-terms review. PRAGMA: vertical artifact templates are a productizable offer.

bullets.title: GitHub Universe: Copilot Fusion GA and agents now start 40%+ of pull requests
bullets.summary: Fusion routes tasks across models and its Max tier is reported within two points of Claude Opus 5.5 Max on the Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index at half the cost; Octoverse says agent drafts began over 40% of September PRs, up from 17% in March.
bullets.how: The Construct: multi-model routing and parallel agent sessions with human-approval gates mirror our orchestration. PRAGMA: adoption data for client pitches. Brand 9 Signs: no.

bullets.title: Google introduces Gemini 4 Carbon, a restricted release for cybersecurity teams
bullets.summary: Google reports 88.2% on SEC-bench Pro and 71% on CWE-bench; it follows Gemini 4 Argon by two weeks.
bullets.how: The Construct: not accessible to us now; watch for broader Gemini 4 availability. PRAGMA: security-audit angle for later. Brand 9 Signs: no.

bullets.title: LlamaIndex proposes an open Document Parsing Protocol (draft 0.1, 140 rules)
bullets.summary: Covers tables, forms and diagrams, is open for public review, and is separate from MCP.
bullets.how: The Construct: a standard to judge our PDF/proof ingestion against. Brand 9 Signs: parsing customer artwork specs and quotes. PRAGMA: document-intake builds for clients.

bullets.title: Dedica launches a free AI-agent website checker with 125 checks
bullets.summary: It tests for tasks that AI agents cannot complete on a site.
bullets.how: Brand 9 Signs: run it on brand9signs.com/shop to find agent-checkout and quoting blockers for AI shopping. The Construct: cheap agent-readiness audit. PRAGMA: reusable client audit.

praxis_lesson: Agent-readiness of our own sites is now measurable: if an AI agent can't complete the quote or checkout flow, that is a lost sale, so audit Brand 9 Signs and client sites for agent-completable tasks the way we audit SEO.
